ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 80% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels concentrated along the trailing edges and a vertical central column.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous field across both lobes. A prominent vertical black band originates at the median notch. Secondary black borders follow the trailing edge. Discrete dark spots are scattered across the mid-region of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are visible along the entire trailing edge, forming a continuous sequence of sharp micro-peaks and shallow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve; a concave trajectory near the median notch transitioning into a broad convex arch towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular dark pixel clusters are detected, particularly a cluster near the upper margin of the right lobe and scattered spots near the fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible on the left lobe, oriented diagonally across the white pigment field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal tip of the left lobe exhibits an irregular, truncated geometric profile compared to the right lobe, indicating localized tissue loss or scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical vertical black pigmentation column centered on the peduncle attachment point.
